control.mode: current static scheduler with virtual dynamic dependencies

symbolic.mode: current direct/virtual dependencies plus symbolic range interval neighbors

interpretation: A symbolic range node can avoid persistent cell-edge storage, but the probe still visited 3,116,386 range neighbors and built 3,691,650 transient unique relations.
Adding all symbolic range descriptors to current static Tarjan changes the SCC partition: 175 cyclic components instead of 84.

The difference is a semantic mapping issue, not a hash/storage issue. Current static scheduling treats compressed range dependencies differently from direct/virtual graph edges and relies on runtime live-edge analysis later.
A symbolic SCC implementation is not production-eligible until this mapping is specified and parity-tested.
